title: Mercedes‑Benz starts large‑scale production of electric axial flux motor
summary: Mercedes-Benz has begun large-scale production of electric axial flux motors at their Berlin plant, marking a significant advancement in EV propulsion technology. This motor type offers higher power density and efficiency compared to traditional radial flux motors, enabling better performance and range for electric vehicles.
problem_solved: Addresses the need for more efficient, compact, and powerful electric motors to improve EV performance and range.
why_valuable: Axial flux motors provide up to twice the power density of conventional motors, enabling lighter vehicles with longer range and better performance.
